The structure of La2Ce2Hg2S8 (LaCeHgS4) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 24 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Ce and Hg each occupy tetrahedral S environments, while La shows an eight-neighbor S coordination; S centers coordinate to one Ce and one Hg. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ce- and Hg-centered tetrahedra and edge-sharing between La and Hg polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
